description: Pixel pass that reconstructs a froxel from screen position plus render-target array layer, samples volume textures, and injects scattering or light into a 3D fog-grid target.

hashFastPaths.evidence: Verified live as broad noise-modulated volumetric injection at event 807.
Verified live as local-light volumetric injection at events 808-810.

checks.meaning: The rasterized froxel is reconstructed from its screen-space position.
The geometry stage or instanced draw supplies the destination 3D texture layer.
The verified permutations declare three volumetric source textures.
This pass operates directly in the fog grid rather than sampling scene-color or G-buffer screens.
The integer render-target layer is converted into the continuous froxel Z coordinate.
Exponential slice-depth reconstruction maps the fog-grid layer into view space.
Three or more 3D source-volume samples contribute to the injected froxel.
The verified UE4 permutations apply the common half-scale encoding to scattering RGB.
Pixels outside the valid injected volume explicitly write no contribution.

runtimeContract.output: float4 scattering, light, density, or extinction contribution into a 3D render-target array
adapterMustConfirm: render target is a 3D texture or array-backed fog grid
